thread:
raina: Quick pulse on the Benchmarks webinar campaign — we shipped the landing and the launch posts yesterday. Need a rapid checklist for: redirects, schema (webinar + post), internal-link boosts, and inbound lead routing. Who can own redirect sweep?

alex: I'll take redirects. Did a quick crawl this morning; 3 legacy paths still 301->root. I'll map and propose rewrite rules by EOD.

sophia: I can do internal link audit across blog + product. Will surface 3 high-priority anchors to push to the landing page.

tom: I'll own structured data. Plan: add Event (schema.org/Event) + FAQ for the landing and JSON-LD on the post. Need final copy for the session times & speakers.

ben: On inbound routing: I'll validate form -> HubSpot mapping, webhook retries, and test lead owner assignment. Also want UTM normalization check in GA.

raina: Perfect. Alex, paste a sample rewrite you plan to use here so infra can sanity-check.

alex: Pasting quick nginx example:

```
# nginx rewrite example
rewrite ^/old-benchmarks/(.*)$ /benchmarks/$1 permanent;
```

I'll attach the full map as a CSV.

tom: For schema, proposed fields: name, startDate, endDate, eventStatus, sameAs (landing URL), organizer, and a small FAQ array. I'll add the JSON-LD draft to the doc after I get speaker blurbs. :white_check_mark:

sophia: Internal links plan: 1) product docs -> landing (CTA anchors), 2) 3 top-ranking blog posts -> landing with 2 contextual links each, 3) update main blog index canonical to /blog with rel=canonical if needed. I'll drop a before/after link table.

ben: Quick ask — can someone create a test lead (test+bench@redwood.example) and hand it to me so I can verify webhook retries? Also, flagging that HubSpot needs column for 'campaign_variant' to route to correct SDR bucket.

raina: I'll create the test lead and add the campaign_variant column. Everyone, add your updates to the launch tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-launch-tracker (please comment where you edit). :eyes:

deploy-bot: Page updated: /benchmarks/landing -> 200 OK (static assets cache cleared)

alex: Uploaded redirect-map.csv to the tracker and flagged three legacy URLs with suggested 301 -> /benchmarks/

sophia: Uploaded link audit CSV (3 priority anchors) and annotated suggested anchor text.

tom: Dropped JSON-LD draft into the doc; left TODOs for speaker bios. Will validate via Rich Results Test after copy finalized.

ben: Ran a test form submission, HubSpot received the webhook. One retry observed, but it succeeded on attempt #2. I've set webhook retry policy to 5 attempts.

raina: Awesome. Final ask: can we do a lightweight post-launch mini-retro on Monday 9am PST to confirm no organic regressions? If yes, I'll book a 30m slot. :calendar:

alex: +1

tom: +1

sophia: +1

ben: +1

raina: Thanks team — great quick turn. Closing out here; record any follow-ups in the tracker.
